title: Part
description: The one part of a crossing message (crossing-2): exactly one body, as text, as raw bytes in standard base64, or as a JSON value, and under the crossing extension its kind and its salt of at least 16 bytes in lowercase hex. A url body counts as the one body, so a part with url and another body has two, and a part whose one body is url is refused by a rule of its own, since url is not a body of this version (crossing-2).

url.description: A url body, whatever its value. It counts as the part's one body, and a part whose body is url is refused by its own rule (crossing-2, url-unsupported).

base64.description: Standard base64 with padding, in the one encoding that decodes and encodes back to itself.
